cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says other registers or services take people's records from the population register.
cells.note: Stage 4: the register is in service with 5.1 million citizens, and the procedures portal (November 2023) enrols children born to Mauritanian parents in it, as a magistrates' official confirms civil-status facts are recorded there. Stage 5 needs other systems taking records from it, and none is held.
